facts.cash_policy: already included in upstream NAV; no external contribution or equity liquidation

market_metadata.execution: signal at t close; execution at next session close
market_metadata.futures_mark: observed close, NOT DF10000500 theoretical settlement
market_metadata.expiry_policy: second Thursday adjusted by supplied index calendar; last quote cross-check; 2026 maturities right censored
market_metadata.option_selection: user-collected monthly put candidates; full historical chain optimality not established
market_metadata.dividend_definition: Daily historical KRX index yield; BSM input proxy, not maturity-specific expected dividends.
market_metadata.margin_policy: Published standalone futures rate history; date inference flags retained; no COMS offsets.

resolved_notice_55.timing_evidence: PDF page 1; prior regular session close

limitations: Historical margin rates include user-authorized inferred effective dates, labelled in the input.
Margin is standalone futures underlying-notional times published rate, without COMS offsets or intraday calls.
Futures P&L and fills use observed closes, not independently verified official settlement prices.
BSM delta uses observed historical KRX index dividend yield and CD91 proxy; forward dividends and an interest-rate curve are not claimed.
Current-constituent upstream equity data omit delisted history; survivorship bias remains.
Upstream revised financial/macro inputs and their timing conventions are inherited.
Only provided put strike candidates are available; optimality over a complete historical chain is not established.
Margin call detected at a close queues reduction at the next close; unmet calls remain reported.
Initial and terminal values are marked NAV; no forced final liquidation.
